plan.purpose: Test price-derived rules, not a return-ranked parameter selector. Primary15m diagnoses original failures;1h fixed independent scale comparison. Never switch timeframe or promote its ex-post winner.
plan.center: HL2 EMA; ER31=abs(close-close31)/sum(abs(each31close change)). alpha=2/90+ER*(2/22-2/90). EffectiveEMA21..89. This is linear adaptive EMA, NOT squared-factor standard KAMA. Endpoints from already discussed ranges, not claimed optimal.
plan.entry: Preserve width EMA(high-low)31, crossing center +/-0.4W, chase limit2W, next-open fill. Only center changes in center arm. Fixed89 and trigger1.2 paired controls test oversensitivity. No confirmed-pivot/future inputs.
plan.risk: Risk arm uses2ATR14 initial absolute distance and4ATR14 activation distance, both frozen at signal close and anchored to actual next fill. No ATR expansion widens initial stop. Original1% and2% otherwise. These multiples are fixed hypotheses, not optimal estimates.
plan.trail: After activation, ratchet to favourable peak minus2currentATR14 (short mirrored), never past loss-side of entry and never loosen. Current closed-bar high/low andATR update next bar only. Original50%giveback otherwise. Gap exit at actual open.
plan.gate: Gate controls require ER31>=0.2 on signal close for entry only. Raw opposite crossing still closes even if gate/chase blocks reverse entry. Original+gate and fulladaptive+gate are both run, never chosen by P&L.0.2 is a fixed hypothesis, not proven predictive.
plan.periods: Continuous2020-10-01 to2026-09-10 with650warmup bars. Report early and later two-year equity growth; same frozen formulas all years. No ranking uses earlier or later profits. Historical data already studied, not untouched holdout.
plan.diagnostic: Exit labels describe loss mechanisms, not sufficient causes. Paired intervention, annuals, sides, frequency, rapid reversal <=4bars, peak before exit, pre-entryER groups and baseline post-entry4/16bar continuation quantify the oversensitivity hypothesis. Forward diagnostics descriptive only and never used for trading. Retain all trades and raw crossing audits.
plan.acceptance: Report whether fulladaptive beats original and is positive on full and later periods separately per asset/timeframe; year count, low win rate and profit concentration disclosed. Do not expand formulas after results to force PAXG/ZEC profitable.
